HYMENAL CONDITIONS

Hymenectomy

Assessment and treatment of hymenal tissue that obstructs the opening.

AT A GLANCE

What this care addresses

A hymenectomy opens or removes hymenal tissue when a congenital variation causes obstruction or symptoms. A septate, microperforate or imperforate hymen may affect menstrual flow or tampon use. An examination establishes whether hymenal tissue is the cause.

Patient information · Canada · Sources checked 8 September 2026

What this care addresses

A hymenectomy opens or removes hymenal tissue when a congenital variation causes obstruction or symptoms. A septate, microperforate or imperforate hymen may affect menstrual flow or tampon use. An examination establishes whether hymenal tissue is the cause.

Cleveland Clinic · Medically indicated hymenal treatment ↗

Assessment and care options

A clinician may recommend a procedure to remove the obstructing tissue. Discuss anaesthesia, bleeding, scarring and injury risks. Recovery instructions should cover activity, vaginal insertion and follow-up; use your clinician’s clearance rather than a general timeline.

When to arrange care

After a procedure, seek medical care for heavy bleeding, fever, pus-like discharge or dizziness.

Cleveland Clinic · Medically indicated hymenal treatment ↗

Questions for your appointment

  • Which finding explains my symptoms?
  • What tissue would be treated, and why?
  • Who will assess healing before I resume activities?

Planning a conversation in Canada

Ask your clinician where an assessment can be arranged and whether a referral is required. Confirm service availability, fees and any coverage directly with the provider and your insurer or provincial plan.
